verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine. Its models ship as plain on-disk checkpoint directories with a standard `config.json` and transformers-style loading, adapters stay as separate unmerged files over a read-only base, and serving uses an OpenAI-compatible API. That limits lock-in and makes switching tools plausible, but nothing documents exporting user data (e.g., chat history or app data from the desktop/mobile apps) or names the open file formats used. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export feature, a documented open format for user data and conversations, confirmation of open weight formats, and independent corroboration.
